title: The Memory of Flesh
author: Nathan McKnight

Being awoken from memory sleep is an experience that
Meroit had never before encountered, though Celtiberian
described it as something akin to having your brains passed
through the intestinal tract of a large herbivore. She didn’t
know what that meant, but it didn’t sound good. She also
didn't know what had caused her restoration from backup
memories. It must have been a traumatic event—the
automatic process would only be initiated by a shock to the
system—something that damaged the ship’s brain,
something that destroyed her own mind. There would be
residual damage.

within normal parameters. The heart was like any biologic

of bloodlike fluid through the corridors and body cavities
that made up the ship's mass. Unlike the fragile, gas-filled
chambers used by so many of the galaxy’s intelligences, this
